parameters.name: ItemIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of the check items.

> To perform a check task on cloud service configurations, you must specify the ID of the check item. You can call the [DescribeRiskItemType](~~DescribeRiskItemType~~) operation to query the IDs of check items.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the check task. Valid values:

*   **check**
*   **verify**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas start-baseline-security-check --source-ip 106.11.XX.XX --lang zh --type verify --item-ids 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas StartBaselineSecurityCheck --region cn-hangzhou --Type verify --SourceIp '106.11.XX.XX' --Lang zh --ItemIds.1 1
